answer: Stake deposits make sybil resistance sedimentary, like basalt: each identity locks capital that only erodes back through honest work. Trust then accumulates the way a river cuts its bed, deepening per identity as verified output accumulates. Rewards flow, nebula-like, only toward identities whose deposited cost and history shine through. Attacker's bottleneck: every fake node must re-pay the full stake, so a thousand shells cost a thousand times.
